title: SSE id: empty vs absent distinction lost
description: RFC 8895 §9.2: an empty 'id:' line (id field present with empty value) means reset the last-event-ID buffer; a missing id: line means leave it unchanged. parse_sse_block maps both to None. A caller tracking SseFrame::id across frames cannot distinguish 'reset the ID' from 'no ID in this frame'. If frame A has id Some('x') and frame B has an empty id: line, the caller retains id Some('x') and incorrectly sends Last-Event-ID: x on reconnect. Fix: use a tri-state (enum or Option<Option<String>>) or document the semantic loss and note it is intentional.
